After being introduced at CES, Belkin has recently started shipping some of its newest MagSafe and Qi2 products for 2026. First up is their slim Qi2 battery bank for iPhone – sporting a built in kickstand.

This is by no means the first slim 5000mAh MagSafe battery bank for iPhone, but the Belkin BoostCharge Slim has one standout feature: a kickstand. This is great for watching videos, FaceTime, or propping up your phone on a desk.

Beyond the kickstand, the Belkin BoostCharge Slim is about everything you’d expect from a 5000mAh MagSafe battery bank. It provides 15W Qi2 charging to your iPhone, but also has the functionality of charging other devices with its USB-C port at up to 20W – in case you want to use it as a normal battery bank.

There’s also dual device charging, allowing you to wire charge a device at 12W and wirelessly charge another at 7.5W.

Despite its slim design, I will say – the BoostCharge Slim surprisingly doesn’t get hot. In my plentiful usage of it, I never noticed it heating up, which can’t always be said about MagSafe accessories.

It comes with a USB-C charging cable in the box, has a nice soft-touch silicone finish on the side that makes contact with your iPhone – and a hard plastic finish on the front.

All in all, if you’re looking to buy a MagSafe battery for your iPhone, whether that be an iPhone Air, iPhone 17 Pro, or anything else, I’d say the Belkin BoostCharge Slim is a great option. The kickstand is a pretty invaluable feature, and it does everything quite well. You can pick one up for $54.99 from Belkin’s website. It comes in three colors: White, Sand, and Black.
